doc.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks Soph, who says he is honored; they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Oh this has been a wonderful conversation and as I said you’ve said some marvelous things about teaching and being a professional, and I really appreciate the time you spent with me.
Oh my pleasure. I’m honored to be in such great company.
Yeah we have a nice list of drummers.
Oh man, musicians period, it’s just crazy. I had no idea the scope of it. It’s great.
Well thank you, Ed. I hope we cross paths sometime in the future —
Well if you’re ever down in the Dallas/Ft. Worth area let me know.
